**Preliminary inventory (current main c8a1913bd, read-only):**
- **Human CLI surface (exists today):** `pkgs/id/src/main.rs` dispatches `Command::Find` (~line 466), `Command::Search` (~486), `Command::Show` (~502), and `Command::Peek` (~516); all four build the same legacy `SearchOptions::new(first, last, count, exclude)` and call `cmd_find` / `cmd_search` / `cmd_show` / `cmd_peek` in `pkgs/id/src/commands/find.rs` (lines 224 / 360), over the shared core `cmd_find_matches` (line 914).
- **Legacy query semantics (the gap vs #5816):** find.rs implements fuzzy name/hash matching only — Exact / Prefix / Contains match types, `--format` tag|group|union, `--first/--last/--count/--exclude` limiting. This is not the #5816 canonical structured query object; the design must map these four verbs onto that object without silently dropping the `--format` / limiting behaviors scripts may already depend on.
- **Scripting/API surface:** the same `cmd_*` handlers are the library entry points (`pub use find::{...}` in `pkgs/id/src/commands/mod.rs`); remote execution goes through `serve`/`client` (`pkgs/id/src/commands/serve.rs`, `client.rs`) with `cmd_find_matches` running against a remote node via `MetaRequest` — so a script/API adapter over the canonical query object has an existing local/remote split to attach to.
- **Agent surface:** no dedicated agent query front door exists yet; the closest surfaces are the REPL (`pkgs/id/src/commands/repl.rs`, `pkgs/id/src/repl/input.rs` — the only other `mcp` mention besides serve.rs) and the web UI (`pkgs/id/src/web/`). The design must state whether the agent door is the REPL, the web/API layer, or a new adapter — without a privileged query path (packet invariant).
- **Settled inputs confirmed fresh:** #5816 CLOSED (canonical query object; names find.rs as the existing CLI surface); #5675 OPEN (parent); #5817, #5819, #5822 OPEN.
